snippet.title: Midgardr | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Midgardr launches January 8th, 2027 and with this trailer, the curtain lifts a little further.

What you've been playing as a strategic board game has another side: a first-person gameplay component that exists beyond the board.
This redefines what kind of game Midgardr actually is.

If you played the demo, you already felt it. If you haven't  now is the time.
Play the demo now on Steam 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645410/Midgardr/

-------------

🎮 Midgardr by Holy Radish
🗓️ coming January 8th, 2027
📍 playable demo on Steam
🏷️ strategy, city building, narrative choices, card game, story-driven

-------------

🎮 About the game:
Midgardr is a medieval board game blending strategy and storytelling, where every choice shapes your fate. It's a solo, turn-based city builder and card game where you play on a game board as a medieval administrator... But maybe you're not just that. And maybe the board isn't all it seems ⁠

✦ Play cards and manage resources to build your settlement and keep your people happy and thriving.
✦ Face moral choices and unpredictable events that threaten peace.
✦ Choose your political allies (Curtes) carefully and encounter mysterious figures offering quests that shape your destiny through branching paths and difficult decisions.

There's more beneath the surface: as you play, you'll begin to uncover a mysterious meta-story hidden behind it all... If you're just a Duke in a board game, who's moving the pieces on the board?

Find out more on Steam 🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3645410/Midgardr/

-------------

Follow Holy Radish on socials 🔗 https://linktr.ee/holyradish
All Hail the Holy Radish
